title: LoopSeek: Decoupling System One Search from System Two Answering for Long Video Understanding
abstract: arXiv:2611.28635v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Long video question answering requires finding relevant evidence before reasoning over it. With a limited frame budget, single-pass frame selection can miss critical evidence, while adaptive search often relies on repeated text generation to decide where to look. We introduce LoopSeek, a framework that decouples evidence search from answer generation through a division of labor between a non-thinking System I and a generative System II. Our key insight is that search can be expressed as a sequence of small, typed decisions, allowing System I to find the evidence that System II needs. Four System I role agents navigate a tree of video windows and coordinate through probability outputs to select frames, assess evidence, and revise the search without generating text. To align search with System II, System I learns from annotated evidence on questions that System II answers correctly only from that evidence, and the verifier's evidence est

translated_title: LoopSeek：面向长视频理解的系统一搜索与系统二回答解耦框架
translated_abstract: 长视频问答需要先找到相关证据，再对其进行推理。在帧数预算有限的情况下，单次帧选择可能会遗漏关键证据，而自适应搜索通常依赖于反复的文本生成来决定搜索位置。我们提出了LoopSeek，一个通过无思考的“系统一”与生成式的“系统二”之间分工协作，将证据搜索与答案生成解耦的框架。我们的关键洞察在于：搜索可以被表达为一序列小型的、类型化的决策，从而使系统一能够找到系统二所需的证据。四个系统一角色智能体在视频窗口树中进行导航，并通过概率输出相互协调，以选择帧、评估证据并修订搜索过程，且全程无需生成文本。为了使搜索与系统二对齐，系统一通过带有标注证据的问题进行学习，这些问题只有基于该证据时系统二才能正确回答（摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: LoopSeek通过四个无需文本生成的“系统一”角色智能体，以小型类型化决策序列在视频窗口树中导航搜索证据，并与“系统二”的回答能力对齐训练，实现了长视频问答中证据搜索与答案推理的高效解耦。
